veranderings.rede: 'In' reads more naturally than 'by' for 'among/within' communities here; meaning unchanged.

veranderings.voor: hoe mense aan kos en rykdom gekom het
veranderings.na: hoe mense aan kos en rykdom kom
veranderings.rede: Matches the timeless label form of the parallel endings 'by wie jy hoort' and 'wie besluit' in the other blocks.

veranderings.voor: Die leier van 'n opperhoofskap, wat besluite vir sy mense neem.
veranderings.na: Die leier van 'n opperhoofskap. Hy neem besluite vir sy mense.
veranderings.rede: 'wat' can be read as referring to 'opperhoofskap' rather than 'leier'; a separate sentence with 'hy' removes the ambiguity.
